'''The secrets of forming Bilar-type claqa group-minds''' was a publication that promised to teach its reader how to form a ''claqa'', or [[Hive mind/Legends|group mind]], like the members of the [[Bilar]] [[Species/Legends|species]] were able to do. The [[Book/Legends|book]] was for sale by the [[Galactic Archives]], a small shop in [[Trader's Plaza]], [[Talos City|Talos]] [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Atzerri/Legends|Atzerri]],<ref name="SOL" /> between [[16 ABY/Legends|16 ABY]] and [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]].<ref name="TERC" /> The Galactic Archives advertised the volume in their courtesy [[Air taxi/Legends|cabs]], which took customers to their central distribution hub. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] viewed an advertisement for the book in such a cab during a search for information about<ref name="SOL" /> his [[Parent/Legends|mother]],<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]. It was advertised alongside the [[H'kig book of laws]], ''[[Principles of Power]]'', and the [[Sith book of offerings and rituals]], with a discount for the purchase of three or more volumes. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] dismissed the advertised volumes as likely frauds.<ref name="SOL" />

==Behind the scenes==
The book was mentioned in ''[[Shield of Lies]]'', the second novel of ''[[The Black Fleet Crisis]]'' trilogy. The novel was written by [[Michael P. Kube-McDowell]] and published in [[1996]].<ref name="SOL" />
